prefill.timing_method: Disjoint intervals between consecutive adapter-observed async completions, attributed to the ending completion phase; first interval starts at first client request. Plugin host sampling/output/scheduling, communication and idle gaps after adapter return fall inside following intervals; final client tail assigned to last phase. Operator decision4 approved attribution. No extra synchronization or live device profiler. Host wall time, not device time.
